about_the_game:
Plushes is a cozy action game about exploration and creature collecting. Become a brave hunter who has to clear the city streets of uninvited guests - cute, but wayward and sometimes aggressive Plushes. Banish them or tame them - the choice is yours!

You'll find yourself on the elegant streets of the snowy city, where secrets hide around every corner. Travel through a variety of locations, fight numerous enemies, solve puzzles, build a personal zoo, trade and engage in other activities to stop the plush invasion.

Turn enemies into friends


Each fluffy guest has its own features: someone immediately gets into a fight, someone sits and sweetly hums a song, and someone doesn't mind getting acquainted with you themselves. All of them require various approaches to capture - and your task is to figure out the most effective tactics by trial and error, turning enemies into friends.

Explore, Collect, Discover

As you move through the story, you'll discover new ways to resist the Plushes. These include different gadgets, equipment and weapons, unique protagonist abilities, and even other Plushes - domesticated and ready to get up alongside you.

Get involved in other activities

  • Build a base

  • Meet game characters

  • Complete side quests and mini-games

  • Find secrets and much more!

short_description: They’re fluffy, reckless… and everywhere! Grab the gadgets, explore cozy streets, collect adorable plushie troublemakers in your personal collection, and upgrade your base. A wholesome action where every trophy is a tiny friend.
